main.description: Create a newsletter campaign. LangGraph curation loop ingests news.etzhayyim.com + narou.etzhayyim.com signals, ranks content, drafts and personalizes per cohort, then delivers via Resend.

topic.description: Content topic / theme for this campaign.

cohortName.description: Target cohort from cohort-apqc-3-market-sell-* table. Empty = all subscribers.

scheduleIso.description: ISO 8601 send time. Empty = send immediately.

includeAdSlot.description: If true, creates an ads.etzhayyim.com sponsor slot in the newsletter.

subjectLine.description: Override subject line. Empty = LangGraph generates.
